intro: More than 500 completed roofing projects across Paulding, Cobb, Douglas and Fulton counties — replacements, storm repairs, commercial flat roofs, soft wash roof cleaning and gutter work. The thing customers mention most often is not the roof itself but what the property looked like when we left: debris cleared as we went, the yard and driveway swept with a magnet for nails, and a final walk together before we called it finished.
